icon_job_scout:
Hand-painted semi-realistic HD isometric game art, like the best classic 2D castle city-builders:
soft painterly shading, rich natural material texture, warm late-summer light from the upper left,
soft shadow to the lower right, tallgrass prairie, lake and oak woodland palette, no outlines,
no text.
Game icon of a tall lookout pole with a small plain pennant, a single painted object, three-quarter view, centred, fills about 80% of
the square, plain flat #00FF00 background, readable at 16 pixels, no frame, no text.
Exactly ONE plain vertical wooden pole with a small undecorated tan triangular cloth pennant tied near its top. Just the single pole and flag. No platform, roof, tower, ladder, buildings, ground or stones. A strong simple silhouette with a slightly thick pole, grey-brown wood, pale hide cloth, no pure black. Empty margin on every side.
